Rashi on Shabbat 151b:10:1.hebrew: אריה אבי תרי לא נפיל - להורגן, כדכתי' "ומוראכם" — תרי, וכתיב "על כל חית הארץ" — ואפי' ארי:
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:10:1.english: A lion does not pounce upon two [people] - To kill them, as it is written: “And the fear of you” [in the plural, indicating] two; and it is written: “upon every beast of the earth” — even a lion.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:10:2.english: In accordance with [that which] Rami bar Abba [said] - That death was decreed upon him, and he appeared to the lion like an animal.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:10:3.hebrew: נמשל - מי שחיה מושלת בו, בידוע שכבהמה נדמה:
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:10:3.english: He is likened - One over whom a wild beast has dominion, it is certain that he appears as a beast.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:11:2.english: While you find - someone for whom to do [it].

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:11:3.english: And [it is] available to you - Money.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:11:4.english: And you are still in your [own] hand - You are still under your [own] control, before you die.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:11:5.hebrew: לא זכות - לא דבר לזכות בו, שכולם עשירים:
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:11:5.english: Neither merit - [There is] nothing through which to gain merit, for everyone is wealthy.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:11:6.english: Nor liability - [No occasion] to harden [one's] heart and close [one's] hand.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:13:1.hebrew: על מדה זו - שלא יבא לידי עניות, דדבר המזומן הוא לבא או עליו או על בנו או על בן בנו:
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:13:1.english: With regard to this condition - That he should not come to poverty, for it is something destined to come either upon him, or upon his son, or upon his grandson.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:14:1.english: And He will give you mercy - [Meaning] that you will have mercy on [His] creatures.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:15:1.english: This is the forehead - The forehead, which is smooth and shines more than the entire face.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:15:2.english: This is [the] nose - For it is the beauty of a person's face.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:15:3.english: This is the soul - As it is written: "The lamp of God is the soul of man" (Proverbs 20:27).

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:15:5.hebrew: ושבו העבים - חשכת עינים יבא ויכסה המאור, אחר שירבה בבכיה בזקנותו מחמת תשות כח וצרות רבות עליו:
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:15:5.english: And the clouds return - Darkness of the eyes will come and cover the light [of his eyes], after he cries much in his old age due to weakness of strength and many troubles upon him.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:16:2.english: Even if it is filled - [with] kohl in his eyes, like a large applicator stick.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:16:3.hebrew: כאביסנא של גרדאי - כובד של גרדיים, אינשובל"ש בלע"ז:
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:16:3.english: Like a weaver's avisana - A weaver's beam, ensoubles in Old French.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:16:4.hebrew: אוקומי - המאור מוקים, שלא יחשיך יותר ממה שהוא:
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:16:4.english: Maintain - it maintains the light [of the eye], so that it does not dim more than it [already] is.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:16:5.hebrew: מאי קמ"ל - בהא דאמר אפי' כאביסנא דגרדאי:
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:16:5.english: What is he teaching us - By that which he said, “even [as thick] as a weaver’s pin.”

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:16:7.hebrew: מכוחלא - עץ שהוא מכניס בשפופרת ונותן בעיניו, וקורין לו מכחול:
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:16:7.english: Mikuchla - A [piece of] wood that one inserts into a tube and puts in his eyes, and they call it a makhchol [applicator stick].

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:17:1.english: Bereavement and blindness - Bereavement of children and blindness [caused by] tears.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:17:2.english: Of crying - [Tears that come] out of mourning and distress.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:1:1.english: That it may wait - So that [the corpse] will not putrefy due to the heat of the sheet and the pillows.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:1:2.hebrew: קושרין את הלחי - של מת שהיה פיו הולך ונפתח, קושרין את לחייו כדי שלא יפתח פיו יותר:
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:1:2.english: One may tie the jaw - Of a deceased person whose mouth was progressively opening, one ties his jaws so that his mouth will not open further.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:1:3.hebrew: ולא שיעלה - להסגר ממה שנפתח, דהיינו מזיז אבר, אלא שלא יוסיף ליפתח:
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:1:3.english: And not so that it will rise - [meaning] to close [back] from what it had opened, for that is moving a limb [of a corpse]; rather, [one ties it] so that it will not continue to open.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:1:4.english: One may support it with a bench - For it has the status of a utensil.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:1:5.english: Not that it should rise - For [doing so] would be [considered] building.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:2:1.english: And he said to him: One may not smear - Thus, something that is forbidden to move is forbidden to smear.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:2:2.hebrew: קרקע בקרקע מיחלף - כלומר, ההוא לאו משום טלטול הוא, אלא משום אשוויי גומות; ואע"ג דמרחץ רצפת אבנים הוא וליכא למיחש לאשוויי גומות, מיחלף מיהא בקרקע אחר:
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:2:2.english: Ground can be confused with ground - That is to say, that [prohibition] is not on account of moving [muktzeh], but rather on account of smoothing out depressions; and even though a bathhouse has a stone floor and there is no concern about smoothing out depressions, it can nonetheless be confused with other ground.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:3:1.english: All the needs of the dead — to include what - [That is, what is included] that we did not learn [in the Mishnah]?

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:3:2.english: Cooling vessels - [Vessels] that bring coolness, such as glass.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:4:1.english: And Solomon also said in his wisdom - That the stomach of a dead person swells and bursts.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:4:2.english: This is the spinal cord - For it is like a cord and white like silver.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:4:3.hebrew: זו אמה - שהוא מעין של תולדה, כמו גולות מים (יהושע טו):
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:4:3.english: This is the member - For it is a spring of procreation, like "springs of water" (Joshua 15).

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:4:4.english: This is excrement - And galgal is an expression of gelal [dung] (Ezekiel 4).

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:4:5.english: Into the pit - That [it] falls into his mouth.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:6:1.hebrew: אין מעצמין - את עיניו בשבת, אפילו אחר יציאת הנפש, דמזיז בו אבר:
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:6:1.english: One may not shut - his eyes on Shabbat, even after the departure of the soul, because he moves a limb of his.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:6:2.hebrew: שופך דמים - כדמפרש בברייתא בגמ', שבטורח מועט מקרב מיתתו:
Rashi on Shabbat 151b:6:2.english: Sheds blood - As [it] explains in a baraita in the Gemara, that with a slight exertion one hastens his death.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:7:1.english: And grasps its two big toes - [He] presses them with his fingers.

Rashi on Shabbat 151b:9:1.english: And the dread of you [veḥittekhem] - An expression of your being alive [ḥiyyutekhem].
